Style the header row of a PDF report table

Source: R/pdf_markup.R
pdf_style_table.Rd

Dark header with white, bold text, white separator lines between the header columns, and light zebra striping of the body rows; cell contents left-aligned and centered vertically

Usage

pdf_style_table(
  tt,
  color = pcgrr::color_palette$report_color$values[1],
  header_color = NULL,
  stripe_color = NULL
)

Arguments

tt

tinytable object

color

main report color (hex), see pdf_report_color() - header and stripe colors are derived from it (darkened/lightened) unless given explicitly

header_color

background color of the header row (hex); default: main report color, darkened

stripe_color

background color of every second body row (hex); default: main report color, lightened

Value

styled tinytable object
